Feature: User login Feature

    Background: 
        Given the user launches the application
        And the user clicks the My Account Icon
        And the user clicks the login button

    Scenario: To verify the valid login  
        When the user enters the "valid" login details
        And click the Login button
        Then the user navigates the success page
        And the user should see the heading "My Account"

    Scenario: To verify the invalid login   
        When the user enters the "invalid" login details 
        And click the Login button
        Then the user get the error message as "Warning: No match for E-Mail Address and/or Password."

Feature: User registration Feature

    Background: 
        Given the user launches the application
        And the user clicks the My Account Icon
        And the user clicks the register button

    Scenario: To verify the valid registration  
        When the user enters the valid registration details 
        And checks the privacy policy option
        And click the Continue button
        Then the user get the success message as "Your Account Has Been Created!"

    Scenario: To verify the valid registration without checking privacy policy  
        When the user enters the valid registration details 
        And checks the privacy policy option
        And click the Continue button
        Then the user get the error message as "Error message"

Feature: Search Feature

    Background: 
        Given the user launches the application

    Scenario: To verify the valid search feature 
        When the user enters the "valid" search key in search box
        And click the search button
        Then the user navigates to the product page
        And the related products should be displayed

    Scenario: To verify the invalid search featurewithout checking privacy policy  
        When the user enters the "invalid" search key in search box
        And click the search button
        Then the user should see the mesage as "No products found"
